{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the first few cleaned values
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Confirm that the QA orders are not present
print("Number of rows with revenue 999999.99 after cleaning:", (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
